title: PAX wardrobe frame
summary: IKEA PAX frame assembly: picture and instruction for every step.

steps.alt: Warning: Tip-over can cause serious or fatal injury. Fix the frame to the wall with the f
steps.text: Tip-over can cause serious or fatal injury. Fix the frame to the wall with the fittings provided.
steps.title: Warning

steps.alt: Tools: You need screwdrivers, a level, hammer, pencil, tape measure, stepladder, drill
steps.text: You need screwdrivers, a level, hammer, pencil, tape measure, stepladder, drill and clamp.
steps.title: Tools

steps.alt: Build it with two people, not alone.
steps.text: Build it with two people, not alone.

steps.alt: Work on a soft surface so the panels don’t get damaged.
steps.text: Work on a soft surface so the panels don’t get damaged.

steps.alt: Stuck? Check the manual, then contact IKEA.
steps.text: Stuck? Check the manual, then contact IKEA.

steps.alt: Parts 1/2: 12 cam bolts, 50 nails, 12 cam locks, 16 dowels, 2 screws, 2 sleeves, 4 small sc
steps.text: 12 cam bolts, 50 nails, 12 cam locks, 16 dowels, 2 screws, 2 sleeves, 4 small screws, 4 caps.
steps.title: Parts 1/2

steps.alt: Parts 2/2: 2 bracket covers, 2 top brackets, 2 wall plates, 2 leg bolts, 2 feet, 2 T-nuts,
steps.text: 2 bracket covers, 2 top brackets, 2 wall plates, 2 leg bolts, 2 feet, 2 T-nuts, 1 nail holder.
steps.title: Parts 2/2

steps.alt: Don’t step or stand on the panels.
steps.text: Don’t step or stand on the panels.

steps.alt: Step 1: Screw one top bracket onto each long side panel, 2 small screws each.
steps.text: Screw one top bracket onto each long side panel, 2 small screws each.
steps.title: Step 1
steps.hint: Match the edge groove in the insets

steps.alt: Step 2: Screw in 2 cam bolts at each of the two spots shown.
steps.text: Screw in 2 cam bolts at each of the two spots shown.
steps.title: Step 2
steps.hint: Use the holes the hand points to

steps.alt: Step 3: Screw in 4 more cam bolts, 2 at each spot shown.
steps.text: Screw in 4 more cam bolts, 2 at each spot shown.
steps.title: Step 3

steps.alt: Step 4: Screw in the last 4 cam bolts, 2 at each spot shown.
steps.text: Screw in the last 4 cam bolts, 2 at each spot shown.
steps.title: Step 4

steps.alt: Step 5: Push 8 wooden dowels into the edges of the two short panels.
steps.text: Push 8 wooden dowels into the edges of the two short panels.
steps.title: Step 5
steps.hint: Match the edge groove in the inset

steps.alt: Step 6: Hammer 2 T-nuts into the holes shown.
steps.text: Hammer 2 T-nuts into the holes shown.
steps.title: Step 6
steps.hint: Not the way that is crossed out

steps.alt: Step 7: Push each leg bolt into a foot until it clicks.
steps.text: Push each leg bolt into a foot until it clicks.
steps.title: Step 7

steps.alt: Step 8: Screw the 2 feet into the T-nuts.
steps.text: Screw the 2 feet into the T-nuts.
steps.title: Step 8

steps.alt: Step 9: Push 8 wooden dowels into the ends of the two rails.
steps.text: Push 8 wooden dowels into the ends of the two rails.
steps.title: Step 9

steps.alt: Ceiling over 244 cm: room to raise the frame. 237–244 cm: it hits the ceiling.
steps.text: Ceiling over 244 cm: room to raise the frame. 237–244 cm: it hits the ceiling.

steps.alt: Step 10: Measure your ceiling height.
steps.text: Measure your ceiling height.
steps.title: Step 10

steps.alt: Choose your build: Ceiling 244 cm or more: open “Lying down”. 237–244 cm: open “Standing up”.
steps.text: Ceiling 244 cm or more: open “Lying down”. 237–244 cm: open “Standing up”.
steps.title: Choose your build

steps.alt: With 244 cm or more, build the frame lying down and raise it at the end.
steps.text: With 244 cm or more, build the frame lying down and raise it at the end.

steps.alt: Step 11: Fit a short panel onto the bolts at one end.
steps.text: Fit a short panel onto the bolts at one end.
steps.title: Step 11
steps.hint: Holes face where the hand points

steps.alt: Step 12: Fit the other short panel onto the bolts at the other end.
steps.text: Fit the other short panel onto the bolts at the other end.
steps.title: Step 12

steps.alt: Step 13: Turn the 6 cam locks to lock the panels.
steps.text: Turn the 6 cam locks to lock the panels.
steps.title: Step 13

steps.alt: Step 14: Slide the two rails down into place as shown.
steps.text: Slide the two rails down into place as shown.
steps.title: Step 14

steps.alt: Step 15: Lower the second side panel onto the bolts.
steps.text: Lower the second side panel onto the bolts.
steps.title: Step 15

steps.alt: Step 16: Turn the 6 cam locks to lock it.
steps.text: Turn the 6 cam locks to lock it.
steps.title: Step 16

steps.alt: Step 17: Turn the frame over so the open back faces up.
steps.text: Turn the frame over so the open back faces up.
steps.title: Step 17

steps.alt: Your back panel may come in one or more pieces. Fit them the same way.
steps.text: Your back panel may come in one or more pieces. Fit them the same way.

steps.alt: Step 18: Lay the back panel on the frame, matching the corner hole.
steps.text: Lay the back panel on the frame, matching the corner hole.
steps.title: Step 18

steps.alt: Step 19: Line up the edges, then nail one corner using the nail holder.
steps.text: Line up the edges, then nail one corner using the nail holder.
steps.title: Step 19

steps.alt: Step 20: Line up the edge and nail the other end.
steps.text: Line up the edge and nail the other end.
steps.title: Step 20

steps.alt: Step 21: Nail the next corner the same way.
steps.text: Nail the next corner the same way.
steps.title: Step 21

steps.alt: Step 22: Nail all around the edges: 47 nails.
steps.text: Nail all around the edges: 47 nails.
steps.title: Step 22

steps.alt: Raise it: Raise the frame upright the way shown, not the crossed-out way.
steps.text: Raise the frame upright the way shown, not the crossed-out way.
steps.title: Raise it

steps.alt: At 237–244 cm the frame hits the ceiling if raised. Build it standing, with a st
steps.text: At 237–244 cm the frame hits the ceiling if raised. Build it standing, with a stepladder.

steps.alt: Step 11: Hold a side panel upright and push both rails onto it.
steps.text: Hold a side panel upright and push both rails onto it.
steps.title: Step 11
steps.hint: Bracket at the top, as in the inset

steps.alt: Step 12: Slide the bottom panel onto the bolts at the base.
steps.text: Slide the bottom panel onto the bolts at the base.
steps.title: Step 12

steps.alt: Step 13: Turn the 3 cam locks to lock it.
steps.text: Turn the 3 cam locks to lock it.
steps.title: Step 13

steps.alt: Step 14: Fit the top panel onto the bolts at the top.
steps.text: Fit the top panel onto the bolts at the top.
steps.title: Step 14

steps.alt: Step 15: Fit the second side panel onto the bolts.
steps.text: Fit the second side panel onto the bolts.
steps.title: Step 15
steps.hint: The bracket goes at the top

steps.alt: Step 16: Turn the 6 cam locks on the second side.
steps.text: Turn the 6 cam locks on the second side.
steps.title: Step 16

steps.alt: Step 17: Turn the last 3 cam locks at the bottom.
steps.text: Turn the last 3 cam locks at the bottom.
steps.title: Step 17

steps.alt: Your back panel may come in one or more pieces. Fit them the same way.
steps.text: Your back panel may come in one or more pieces. Fit them the same way.

steps.alt: Step 18: Place the back panel against the back of the frame.
steps.text: Place the back panel against the back of the frame.
steps.title: Step 18

steps.alt: Step 19: Hold it in place and nail it using the nail holder: 25 nails.
steps.text: Hold it in place and nail it using the nail holder: 25 nails.
steps.title: Step 19

steps.alt: Step 20: Go to the other side and nail 25 more.
steps.text: Go to the other side and nail 25 more.
steps.title: Step 20

steps.alt: Warning: An unfixed frame can tip over. Always fix it to the wall.
steps.text: An unfixed frame can tip over. Always fix it to the wall.
steps.title: Warning

steps.alt: Step 21: Fit the 2 wall plates into the top brackets.
steps.text: Fit the 2 wall plates into the top brackets.
steps.title: Step 21

steps.alt: Step 22: Level the frame by turning the 2 feet with a screwdriver.
steps.text: Level the frame by turning the 2 feet with a screwdriver.
steps.title: Step 22

steps.alt: Step 23: Adjust and tighten the 2 wall brackets, then click on the covers.
steps.text: Adjust and tighten the 2 wall brackets, then click on the covers.
steps.title: Step 23

steps.alt: Step 24: Press the 4 caps into the holes at the top and bottom.
steps.text: Press the 4 caps into the holes at the top and bottom.
steps.title: Step 24

steps.alt: Placing a second frame next to the first: follow the inset, not the crossed-out
steps.text: Placing a second frame next to the first: follow the inset, not the crossed-out one.

steps.alt: Adjust the 2 feet of the second frame, then move it into place.
steps.text: Adjust the 2 feet of the second frame, then move it into place.

steps.alt: To join two frames you need a drill with a 5 mm bit and a clamp.
steps.text: To join two frames you need a drill with a 5 mm bit and a clamp.

steps.alt: Step 1: Fit the wall plates on the second frame, as in step 21.
steps.text: Fit the wall plates on the second frame, as in step 21.
steps.title: Step 1

steps.alt: Step 2: Level the second frame with its 2 feet.
steps.text: Level the second frame with its 2 feet.
steps.title: Step 2

steps.alt: Step 3: Fix the second frame to the wall and click on the covers.
steps.text: Fix the second frame to the wall and click on the covers.
steps.title: Step 3

steps.alt: Step 4: Clamp the frames together and drill through at the holes shown, top and bottom.
steps.text: Clamp the frames together and drill through at the holes shown, top and bottom.
steps.title: Step 4

steps.alt: Step 5: Join the frames with the 2 screws and sleeves.
steps.text: Join the frames with the 2 screws and sleeves.
steps.title: Step 5
